title: Guard every Engram test fixture that writes under --home, from one shared snippet
outcome: tm-47g6 added an outside-test-root refusal (exit 3) to engram-control-fixture.{ps1,sh}: the home must sit below a termal/tests segment after GetFullPath (ps1) and any '..' segment is refused (both). engram-work-binding-fixture.{ps1,sh} still appends work-read-phases / work-next-read / work-lock-retried under --home and engram-doctor-pipe-fixture.{ps1,sh} creates a pipe and launches engram-descendant.* from --home, all unguarded. If a test ever resolves one of them against an unscoped default home the same write into a real ~/.engram recurs. Do: (1) move the guard into a dot-sourced/sourced snippet (src/tests/fixtures/engram-fixture-home-guard.{ps1,sh}) so the rule cannot drift between scripts; (2) apply it to work-binding and doctor-pipe fixtures; (3) extend the refusal test in src/tests/engram_fixture_contracts.rs to drive each fixture with a direct outside home and a '..' traversal alias; (4) first verify every caller passes a TestTempRoot-derived home. Known remaining gap, deliberately not closed: a symlink placed under termal/tests that points at a real home is not resolved (the guard is lexical, matching test_temp_paths.rs which also does not canonicalise OS-temp aliases). Raised by both /review-code reviewers on tm-47g6.
